title: REQ · config.ts, createGame.ts and events.ts use only Phaser 3.90 APIs
summary: Game config, factory and event bus are 3.90-compatible and documented as such
description: Context: config.ts builds GameConfig with Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT and render options. createGame.ts calls new Phaser.Game. events.ts has no Phaser dependency. Desired behavior: these modules use 3.90 equivalents only and state the 3.90 target. Expected result: no Phaser 4-only symbol appears in them. Why: protects the 3.90 pin.
acceptance_criteria: Given buildGameConfig, when called with a parent element and scenes, then it returns type Phaser.AUTO, width 640, height 360 and render.pixelArt true.
Given createGame, when called with phaser mocked, then new Phaser.Game receives the config from buildGameConfig.
Given events.ts, when its imports are read, then it imports nothing from phaser.
definition_of_done: Modules carry a 3.90 target comment and use only 3.90 APIs
